analytics-bot: Note: add hidden fields: utm_campaign, product_mode, estimated_monthly_tokens for routing and lead scoring.
ella: Great. Also include benchmark blurb but with method link and asterisk: 'Up to 40% lower median per-token latency in our internal 8k-context benchmark.*' -- legal to approve.
neha: I'll prepare two headline variants for A/B: Variant 1 (capabilities-first), Variant 2 (cost-and-reliability). Schedule test 2 weeks post-launch.
tom: Landing form routing mapping draft: twitter->marketing-inbound, organic->sales-ops, product_mode=private->enterprise-sales, webinar->webinar-list. I'll paste JSON into the doc.
ella: Perfect. I'll lock copy in 36h and push to web team. Thanks everyone :tada:
